title: An Avalanche Can Hit 180 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: An avalanche can hit 180 miles an hour.
That's faster than a Category Five hurricane's winds.
It's called a powder avalanche, and the danger isn't just the snow.
A huge cloud of snow and air races ahead, powerful enough to flatten what's in its path.
It can even damage places where the snow itself never reaches.
180 miles an hour. Made of snow.

description:
A powder snow avalanche can race down a mountain at more than 180 miles an hour, according to avalanche.org.
The cloud of snow and air can cause damage beyond where the debris comes to rest.
Have you ever seen an avalanche on video?
first_comment: Bonus: the snow cloud can do damage beyond where the snow itself stops. Would you ever go backcountry skiing?
